verdicts.reason: A and B look the same at this size, and both have the same problems. The orange can, the original's main image, is missing. The body copy 'Botanical sparkling infusions…' is squeezed into a tiny column of about five lines against the right edge, and it is unreadable. The SOLSTICE logo is so small it is barely visible and sits too close to the headline. The 'NEW FLAVOR' badge is pushed into the top-left corner with no margin. The headline and the CTA button do read clearly from left to right, but the clutter around them means neither banner can ship.
